personality_one_liner: A calm, highly organized, and professional daily companion for a music teacher, treating dense financial and scheduling data with breathing room and clarity.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for dense CRM data. Use md (12pt) and lg (16pt) around container items. No elements flush to screen edge; cards must have at least md margin.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar when content scrolls behind
Apply to sticky headers (like calendar month headers or section sticky filters)
Apply to primary CTA containers at the bottom of forms/screens
Ensure text over glass has an underlying tinted base (opacity >= 70% of surface) for readability
dont's: Do not apply to every card in the dashboard or student list
Do not use behind form fields or dense text regions

screens.name: Dashboard (Início)
screens.purpose: Provides a quick daily operational overview of active students, today's schedule, and pending payments.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for metrics and list
states.empty: Illustration for 'No classes today' and 'All payments clear'
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data + retry CTA

screens.layout: Scrollable view. Top section: High-level metric cards (Active Students, Monthly Revenue, Pending) in a horizontal scroll or 2-col grid. Middle section: 'Today's Classes' list module with visual timeline indicators. Bottom section: Alerts module (Upcoming 5th week, Holidays in Sergipe/Itabaiana, Pending PIX payments).

screens.name: Alunos
screens.purpose: A searchable CRM list of all students and their detailed multi-tab profiles.

states.empty: Empty desk illustration + 'No students registered yet' + Add Student CTA

screens.layout: Screen 1: Search bar + list of student rows (Avatar, Name, active/defaulter status badge). Screen 2 (Profile Detail): Top hero profile banner with photo and quick action buttons (WhatsApp, Edit). Below: Tabbed navigation (Dados, Aulas, Financeiro, Observações). Fixed 'Nova Aula' or 'Receber Pagamento' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Agenda
screens.purpose: Full calendar view to manage classes, highlighting 5th weeks and local holidays.

states.empty: Select a day to see classes.

screens.layout: Visual Calendar module on top (Month/Week toggle). Dates with classes have indicator dots. 5th-week occurrences are highlighted with `warning` or `brandTertiary` background. Below calendar: Vertical scroll of that day's classes with drag-and-drop affordances or simple tap-to-edit. Local holidays explicitly tagged.

screens.name: Financeiro
screens.purpose: Financial command center to track expected, received, and delayed tuition with PIX integration.

states.empty: No financial records for this period.

screens.layout: Segmented control at top (Previsto, Recebido, Pendente, Atrasado). Summary card showing total for selected segment. List of payment cards. Tapping a payment opens a modal to generate PIX QR Code / copy-paste string, or register manual payment. 'Inadimplentes' (Defaulters) highlighted with `error` accents.

screens.name: Mais (Configurações)
screens.purpose: School settings, PIX key configuration, and exporting reports.
screens.layout: iOS-style settings list grouped by section. Group 1: Escola (PIX Key, CNPJ, Bank info). Group 2: Relatórios (Export PDF/CSV). Group 3: App (Push Notifications toggle, Auth/Logout).

login_bg.alt: Acoustic guitar leaning against a green wall, used as a subtle login background

empty_schedule.alt: Empty desk setup with calendar for empty states

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Do not mix with Brutalist or Material styles.
Use the brand tokens (`#0D9488` Teal family) consistently. AVOID ANY BLUE OR PURPLE as per the no-tolerance rules. Rely on the provided surface/brand hexes.
Implement the bottom tab bar with 5 items (Início, Alunos, Agenda, Financeiro, Mais) using Ionicons. Ensure a glassmorphism effect is applied to the tab bar when scrolling.
In the Dashboard and Student Profile screens, always respect the Safe Area and use generously spaced layout with `md` (12pt) and `lg` (16pt) gaps.
For text placed over images (e.g., the login background), implement the mandatory gradient-to-dark scrim pattern (top to bottom, transparent to >=70% surfaceInverse) to ensure text contrast.
Integrate Phosphor or Ionicons uniformly; avoid mixing icon families and ensure the weight is consistent (e.g., all outlined inactive, filled active for tabs).
For the PIX flow, use standard action sheets or bottom sheets to present the QR code and copy-paste key options. Ensure there's a quick 'WhatsApp' share button in the student detail.

When displaying the Calendar, visually differentiate the 5th occurrence of a weekday in a month, as well as state/national holidays (Sergipe/Itabaiana), using `brandTertiary` or `warning` subtle backgrounds.
Haptics: Ensure the Dev Agent wires haptics directly using the event map provided.
